summary: Validated bug fix: PUT /api/spare-parts/{id} now persists equipment_type, nom, and reference_fabricant (previously stripped by SparePartUpdate Pydantic model). Verified via both pytest (2/2 passed) and end-to-end UI via Playwright on /stock page.
critical_code_review_comments: SpareParts.jsx is 844 lines — consider splitting into smaller focused components (list, modals, filters).
server.py is ~5700 lines — should be modularised into routers per resource for maintainability.
AuthContext uses localStorage for JWT (XSS risk). Consider httpOnly cookies if security requirements warrant.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates and deletes TEST_ prefixed spare parts (auto-cleanup). UI test edited an existing part (Kit déverseur LB78, id 2c07544e-...) then reverted nom/ref/equipment_type to originals via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Spare parts page route is /stock (not /pieces-detachees). Edit menu opens via DropdownMenu — use get_by_role('menuitem', name='Modifier'). Note: get_by_text('Modifier') matched the sidebar link 'Modifier mon mot de passe' and navigated away, so always use exact menuitem role. Login via UI is flaky (playwright fill on the email field appears not to persist reliably) — recommend seeding token via localStorage after calling /api/auth/login directly.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: SparePartUpdate Pydantic model only exposed quantite_stock/seuil_minimum/emplacement/fournisseur/prix_unitaire. FastAPI validated the incoming payload against this model, silently dropping equipment_type, nom, reference_fabricant before the MongoDB $set. Fix (backend/server.py:518-526) adds nom, reference_fabricant, equipment_type as Optional[str]. Verified: PUT with all three fields returns updated values, GET confirms DB persistence, UI reload shows the new values in the list and re-opened edit form.
